description: dotnet new templates for a production-ready modular monolith: vertical slices with explicit mappers, Wolverine (mediator, transactional outbox, optional RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus), EF Core with a schema per module, .NET Aspire, Serilog, OpenTelemetry and tests. Includes ms-sln (solution), ms-module and ms-feature.
title: Monoslice – Modular Monolith templates for .NET
